method.boolean_validation: Removed union/intersection and stock partitions are checked. Whole intersection/union use De Morgan complement Booleans when stock-contained. Failed attempts retry coplanar-face unification, fuzzy tolerance 1e-7 mm, shared rigid rotations, and General Fuse Boolean cell partitions with source-volume and bounding-stock checks. All rejected attempts are retained. Unresolved comparisons are null, not fabricated scores; initial unchecked results are not used.
method.determinism: Fixed seeds; numeric JSON rounded to 8 decimals; no timestamps or timings in report. Runtime logs are not part of deterministic evidence.
method.failures: Archived exec_ok=false always scores zero; no generated scripts executed. Audit/runtime errors are null and separate, never silently zero.
method.hidden_coordinate_drift: Visible-versus-latent difference is specification information loss, not attributed to model error.
method.independence: Independent reference CONSTRUCTION; same FreeCAD/OCC geometry kernel, not a second kernel.
method.latent_definition: Full-precision size+pockets+holes directly from current generator.
method.pairing: Require seed/unique IDs/contract stock calls, geometric gold stock and first-pocket checks, run stock checks, and reproduction of the original raw whole/removed-IoU operations on archived STEP pairs. Raw reproduction is only a pairing guard, never a validated score; corrected-minus-legacy differences are retained. These are consistency checks, not proof of original prompt identity.
method.prompt_provenance: Raw archived prompt unavailable. Text reconstructed from CURRENT generator with seed 20261106; not claimed to be the preserved original prompt.
method.reference: Direct Part boxes/cylinders, union all cutters before stock subtraction; no nominal full-volume rejection.
method.visible_definition: float('%.0f' % value) for every printed dimension and coordinate; unprinted through-hole depth ignored.
